```{python}
#| output: asis

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio

pio.templates.default = "plotly_white"

df = h.communication_attendees_by_department()
df["Department"] = df["Department"].map(lambda d: h.DEPT_ABBREVIATIONS.get(d, d))
fig = px.bar(df, x="Attendees", y="Department", text="Attendees",
             title="RDM Training Attendees by Department")
fig.update_traces(marker_color="#742459")
fig.update_layout(
    yaxis={"categoryorder": "total ascending"},
    margin={"t": 100},
)
print(h.render_chart(fig))
print(h.render_department_abbreviations())
print('<p style="font-size:0.85em;color:#6b7280"><i>University-wide = RDM training '
      'activities (PROOF &amp; DataBites), not tied to a single department.</i></p>')
```

## How to improve the implementation for the next year, 2026-2027

### What we can do

#### Amplify RDM policy awareness

- At the Data Steward team, we will continue to publish news items to inform and
  remind researchers about the RDM policy
- Plan more visits to the research groups to present the policy and introduce
  their data Steward
- We plan to organize a symposium about Research Cockpit to increase the
  awareness

#### Enhance training uptake

- We have revamped the [PROOF course on Open Science and
  RDM](https://tuenl.sharepoint.com/sites/intranet-human-resources-management/SitePages/Archive-2024/Open-Science----PhD,-PDoc.aspx)
  to include training on how to make DMPs
- We have created [RDM guidelines for PhD
  supervisors](https://rdm.tue.nl/docs/category/skill-building--learning)
- We are preparing an e-learning course about Research Data Management

### What you can do

You can help us by inviting us to your staff meetings. Please email
rdmsupport@tue.nl or reach out to your data steward directly ([Find your data
steward](https://rdm.tue.nl/docs/contact/)).
